description: Java source code for a REST API resource class managing business step configurations in the Fineract project. It provides endpoints to list jobs, retrieve and update business step configurations, and list available steps for a given job.

classes.name: ConfigureBusinessStepApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing business step configurations, annotated with JAX-RS and Spring annotations.

methods.name: retrieveAllConfiguredBusinessJobs
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all configured business jobs.

methods.name: retrieveAllConfiguredBusinessStep
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve business step configurations for a specific job.

methods.name: updateJobBusinessStepConfig
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update the execution order of business steps for a specific job.

methods.name: retrieveAllAvailableBusinessStep
methods.description: Handles GET request to list available business steps for a specific job.
